verdict.rationale: Lium's billing docs state that pods are billed per second (`hourly price × seconds / 3600`) with no minimum, and llms.txt repeats 'billed per second'. TTL, end-time and spend-cap auto-removal, plus the CLI's per-pod spend view, suggest charges stop once a pod is removed. missing for 10: explicit documentation that billing stops when an instance is stopped or removed (including any storage or volume charges afterward), independent or hands-on corroboration of the per-second billing.
